title: Undo/takeback: schema or server concern?
description: Should the schema declare whether undo is permitted? This affects the server protocol (can a confirmed move be rescinded?). Some games allow takebacks by convention (casual chess), some forbid them (tournament chess), some have explicit undo mechanics (Azul). Is this a per-game-definition boolean, a per-move attribute, or a server policy outside the schema?
close_reason: Split: game-mechanical undo is a phase rule (allow_undo_before_commit). Social takebacks are server/room policy. Schema handles game mechanics, server handles social conventions.
